title: Santa Photos at Joplin Greenhouse
seo_title: Santa Photos at Joplin Greenhouse in Joplin, MO
description: Families can have free holiday photos taken with Santa at Joplin Greenhouse, with professional photography and editing by Rained on Photography. You can also get a drink from the Winter Menu and browse live Christmas trees, poinsettias, and holiday goodies; donations to the photographer are welcome, and photos will be shared in an online album on Rained on Photography's Facebook page afterward. It takes place on November 21, 2026, with Santa there from 10 AM to 12 PM, at 2820 E 32nd St in Joplin, MO.
